name: Ambiguous Custom Block Signature
hint: Names for custom blocks are non-unique. Two custom blocks with the same name can only be distinguished if they have a different number or order of parameters.[newLine]Try to always make the names for custom blocks unique.
instruction: Names for custom blocks are non-unique. Two custom blocks with the same name can only be distinguished if they have a different number or order of parameters.[newLine]Try to always make the names for custom blocks unique.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
define Jump
move (10) steps
turn left (180) degrees
move (10) steps

define Jump :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
move (10) steps
turn right(180) degrees
move (10) steps

When green flag clicked
Jump
Jump //⇦  🐛

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
define JumpLeft
move (10) steps
turn left (180) degrees
move (10) steps

define JumpRight :: #007000 //⇦  👍
move (10) steps
turn right (180) degrees
move (10) steps

When green flag clicked
JumpLeft
JumpRight //⇦  👍
